body.name: Branch-dual saddle handle for unrestricted-allocation eliminate-one designs
body.construction: For the variance vector \(s\), optimize the joint finite-branch Gaussian rate over an interior first-batch allocation \(a\in\mathcal W\), a first-batch fraction, and branch-specific interior allocations on the \(K-1\) survivors after one arm is eliminated, using the dual multipliers of the eliminate-one and terminal polyhedra as a saddle-point certificate over the explicitly eliminate-one-only class \(\mathfrak D_2^{\mathrm{all}}\). Optimization over the number of eliminated arms is not included in this residual handle.
